title: DECISION: Codec constants in single file prevent silent drift
description: crates/core/src/ipld/codec.rs defines CODEC_RAW (0x55), CODEC_DAG_CBOR (0x71), and MH_SHA2_256 (0x12) as named constants with comments referencing the multicodec registry table. These are the sole source of truth used everywhere CIDs are constructed. If the codec strategy changes (unlikely but possible) there is one place to change and it is obvious. A future contributor might inline the hex values at each call site for brevity, making it impossible to audit which code uses which codec and easy to silently mix up 0x55 and 0x71.
